title: AI Traction Fuels Snowflake’s (SNOW) Guidance Boost

content_html:
Soumya Eswaran

Fri, July 31, 2026 at 7:04 AM PDT 3 min read

Spyglass Capital Management LLC, an investment management firm, released its second-quarter investor letter for "Spyglass Growth Strategy". A copy of the letter can be downloaded here. Spyglass Growth Strategy appreciated 24.63% in the second quarter, significantly outperforming the Bloomberg Midcap Growth Index's 14.05% increase, the Bloomberg 2500 Growth Index's 19.01% gain, and the Bloomberg 500 Index's 15.61% return for the same period. The Strategy's performance in Q2 was a reversal from Q2 driven by easing geopolitical tensions, notably a US-Iran ceasefire, declining oil prices, and a rebound in software stocks after early-year volatility. Small caps and growth stocks outperformed, with Technology, Industrials, and Financials leading sectors. The portfolio's earnings growth remains above 40%, while current valuations do not yet reflect this performance. Despite recent portfolio success—85% of companies exceeding revenue estimates—the overall portfolio faces multiple compression with a slight negative year-to-date return. However, the firm remains confident that fundamentals will prevail over volatility, emphasizing that the market's short-term inefficiencies may present opportunities for value extraction. In addition, please check the Firm's top five holdings to know its best picks in 2026.

Spyglass Growth Strategy's Q2 2026 investor letter highlighted Snowflake Inc. (NYSE:SNOW) as a significant performance driver. Based in Bozeman, Montana, Snowflake Inc. (NYSE:SNOW) is a cloud-based data platform company that enables customers to unify, manage, and collaborate on data across multiple cloud providers. On July 30, 2026, Snowflake Inc. (NYSE:SNOW) closed at $298.10 per share. One-month return of Snowflake Inc. (NYSE:SNOW) was 14.59%, and its shares gained 45.40% over the past 52 weeks. Snowflake Inc. (NYSE:SNOW) has a market capitalization of $103.32 billion.

Spyglass Growth Strategy stated the following regarding Snowflake Inc. (NYSE:SNOW) in its Q2 2026 investor update:

"Snowflake Inc. (NYSE:SNOW), a provider of cloud data warehouse software, was a top contributor during the second quarter. Snowflake's first-quarter results exceeded consensus expectations for both revenue and earnings. We continue to be impressed by the Company's product innovation, and, importantly, Snowflake saw enough traction with one of its early AI products to raise guidance while attributing the increase specifically to that product. We believe Snowflake's long term potential remains misunderstood by most investors. While we trimmed our position size during the quarter due to share price appreciation, Snowflake remains a core position."

太平洋夏令时间 2026 年 7 月 31 日星期五上午 7:04 阅读时间 3 分钟

投资管理公司 Spyglass Capital Management LLC 发布了“Spyglass Growth Strategy”第二季度投资者信函。 该信函的副本可以在此处下载。 Spyglass Growth Strategy第二季度涨幅为24.63%，大幅跑赢彭博中型成长指数14.05%的涨幅、彭博2500成长指数19.01%的涨幅以及彭博500指数同期15.61%的回报率。 该策略在第二季度的表现与第二季度出现逆转，原因是地缘政治紧张局势缓和，特别是美伊停火、油价下跌以及软件股在年初波动后反弹。 小盘股和成长股表现优于大盘，其中科技、工业和金融板块处于领先地位。 该投资组合的盈利增长仍保持在 40% 以上，而目前的估值尚未反映这一表现。 尽管最近的投资组合取得了成功——85%的公司超出了收入预期，但整体投资组合面临多重压缩，年初至今回报率略有负值。 然而，该公司仍然相信基本面将战胜波动，并强调市场的短期低效率可能会带来价值提取的机会。 此外，请查看该公司的前五名持股，以了解其 2026 年的最佳选择。

Spyglass Growth Strategy 2026 年第二季度投资者信强调 Snowflake Inc.（纽约证券交易所股票代码：SNOW）是重要的业绩驱动因素。 Snowflake Inc.（纽约证券交易所代码：SNOW）总部位于蒙大拿州博兹曼，是一家基于云的数据平台公司，使客户能够跨多个云提供商统一、管理和协作数据。 2026 年 7 月 30 日，Snowflake Inc.（纽约证券交易所代码：SNOW）收于每股 298.10 美元。 Snowflake Inc.（纽约证券交易所股票代码：SNOW）的一个月回报率为 14.59%，其股价在过去 52 周内上涨了 45.40%。 Snowflake Inc.（纽约证券交易所股票代码：SNOW）的市值为 1033.2 亿美元。

Spyglass Growth Strategy 在其 2026 年第二季度投资者更新中对 Snowflake Inc.（纽约证券交易所股票代码：SNOW）做出了以下陈述：

“云数据仓库软件提供商 Snowflake Inc.（纽约证券交易所股票代码：SNOW）是第二季度的最大贡献者。 Snowflake 第一季度的营收和盈利均超出了市场普遍预期。 我们仍然对公司的产品创新印象深刻，而且重要的是，Snowflake 看到了其早期人工智能产品之一的足够吸引力，因此提高了指导，同时将增长专门归因于该产品。 我们认为大多数投资者仍然误解了 Snowflake 的长期潜力。 尽管由于股价上涨，我们在本季度削减了头寸规模，但 Snowflake 仍然是核心头寸。”
